nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What is the primary characteristic of the forest habitat (MH2) surveyed?
nodes.answer: The forest habitat (MH2) is characterized by mature humid tropical forest with relatively low canopy.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life on land|Deforestation prevention|Forest habitat preservation_qna_001
nodes.label: Ecology
nodes.question: What are variable retention silvicultural practices and what purpose do they serve?
nodes.answer: Variable retention silvicultural practices involve retaining mature habitat clumps in harvested areas to provide resources for some forest species, such as brushtail possums.
